archetypes.name: dyn-breadcrumb-rounds
archetypes.rationale: Changed progress breadcrumb text across design and implement review paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed review breadcrumb emissions for missed sub-phase call sites or accidental changes to outer-loop breadcrumbs. Check that the live round number is used consistently and that early-return paths still emit the prefixed first breadcrumb before returning. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
